theme_archetype.rationale: For a premium nightclub discovery app comparable to Resy/Airbnb, we use a Luxury cinematic dark base (Archetype 5) mixed with selective high-energy neon accents (Archetype 7) to reflect nightlife energy without feeling cheap or cluttered. The design avoids pure black, utilizing a deep obsidian base.

background.description: Deepest Obsidian (Tailwind Zinc 950) - not pure black. Keeps interface rich.

surface.description: Zinc 900 and 800 for cards, bottom sheets, and elevated elements.

brand_accents.primary_usage: Main CTA buttons, Swipe 'Like' actions, Heart icons
brand_accents.secondary_usage: VIP tags, Rating stars, Premium events
brand_accents.tertiary_usage: Map markers, 'Open Now' indicators, active tab indicator

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use large padding for screens to feel premium.

swipe_card.layout: Absolute positioned stack. Full bleed image.
swipe_card.interaction: framer-motion drag. Rotate on drag. Opacity overlays for 'Like' (Magenta) and 'Nope' (Zinc).
swipe_card.metadata: Anchored to bottom: Club Name (H2), Distance, Music Genres (Chips).

chips.style: bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/5 text-white text-xs px-3 py-1 rounded-full

map_markers.style: Cyan (#00F0FF) glow effect on dark map theme. Custom HTML markers if React Leaflet, or styled SVGs.

bottom_tab_bar.active_state: Text and Icon colored Cyan (#00F0FF). Inactive is Zinc-500.

Onboarding: Screen 1: Discover. Full screen background image. H1 text.
Screen 3: Geolocation prompt with Gold accent button.
screens.Auth: Email/Google. Minimalist. Glassmorphism inputs. Bottom sheet style on top of blurred background.
screens.Home_Discovery: Vertical feed. 'Open Now' pulse animations. Premium club cards.
screens.Map: Interactive map (React Leaflet or Mapbox). Dark theme styling. Floating search/filter pill at top.
screens.Swipe: Tinder-style deck. 80vh card height. Floating action buttons at bottom (X and Heart).
screens.Club_Detail: Hero image gallery with parallax. Sticky header on scroll. 'Reserve' or 'Add to Favorites' fixed bottom bar.
screens.Filters: Bottom sheet modal. Distance slider. Music genre multi-select chips.
screens.Events: List of upcoming parties. Calendar row at top. Event cards with DJ names and entry price.
screens.Notifications: Chronological list of alerts (Promotions, new events).

micro_interactions.heart_burst: Scale up to 1.5, rotate slightly, fade out (framer-motion)
micro_interactions.list_stagger: Fade in and slide up (y: 20 -> 0) with 0.1s staggerChildren

icons.rules: Use stroke-width 1.5 or 2. No emojis. Consistent sizing (w-6 h-6 for tabs).

paris_nightclubs.description: Concert Crowd - La Machine du Moulin Rouge

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a mobile web app acting like a native app. Build it mobile-first (max-w-md mx-auto h-screen overflow-hidden relative) to simulate a mobile device if viewed on desktop.
Build the Swipe screen using framer-motion (drag='x', useTransform for rotation and opacity overlays).
Ensure the bottom tab bar is fixed at the bottom with z-50 and glassmorphism styling.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='tab-discover', data-testid='swipe-like-btn').
Apply the Typography scales precisely. Do NOT use default Inter font for headings.
For the map, if react-leaflet is used, ensure the tile layer is a dark theme variant (e.g., CartoDB Dark Matter).
Do NOT use pure white or pure black. Use the hex codes provided in this JSON.
Implement tactile feedback (scale animations on click) for all buttons and cards.
